pool.text: A centered feature matrix \( \mathbf{X} \) has shape \( N \times 14 \). What is the size and symmetry property of the sample covariance matrix \( \mathbf{\Sigma} = \frac{1}{N-1}\mathbf{X}^T\mathbf{X} \)?
pool.sol: Since \( \mathbf{X} \) has \( 14 \) columns, \( \mathbf{X}^T \) is \( 14 \times N \) and \( \mathbf{X}^T\mathbf{X} \) is \( 14 \times 14 \). Furthermore, \( (\mathbf{X}^T\mathbf{X})^T = \mathbf{X}^T(\mathbf{X}^T)^T = \mathbf{X}^T\mathbf{X} \), proving it is always symmetric.
